title: Spring Cleaning (Erasing Safely)
hints: Erasing inside a range-for loop invalidates the loop's iterators - undefined behavior. Do not do it.
C++20: std::erase_if(container, predicate) removes every matching element in one pass, for vectors AND maps, and returns how many were removed.
sorted_unique: sort, then std::unique moves duplicates to the end and returns where they start; erase from there to end().
